status.label: Retest mappings outside PowerToys windows
status.detail: The reporter confirmed mappings work only while a PowerToys window is focused, even while PowerToys is running; prior requests for keyboard model and diagnostics were not answered.

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed in a maintainer exchange that mappings work only with PowerToys windows focused, even while the app is running. A maintainer already explained that Keyboard Manager runs in the background and asked for the keyboard model and /bugreport; the reporter said they would provide it later but did not. The issue is from v0.86.0 and needs a current retest with a concrete mapping. AI-suggested issue #32412 is a different startup-after-reboot problem and is closed as a duplicate of #31375, so it does not cover this foreground-only symptom.
evidence: The report lists v0.86.0 and says mappings stop outside PowerToys windows.
The reporter confirmed the symptom persists while PowerToys is running and only works when a PowerToys window is focused.
A maintainer requested the keyboard model and /bugreport; the reporter said they would send it later, but no report was attached.
AI suggested #32412, but that closed issue concerns mappings after reboot until PowerToys restarts, not focus-dependent operation.
A later comment asks about v0.100.2 but has no reporter response.
judgment.recommended_action: Retest one exact mapping on v0.102.3001 in a non-PowerToys window and provide the keyboard model; if it still depends on focus, submit a current /bugreport.

fix_assessment.rationale: Keyboard Manager is expected to process remaps in the background while PowerToys runs; a focus-dependent failure would be a defect, but the report is old and lacks the requested environment details.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Keyboard Manager remaps active outside PowerToys windows
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Keyboard Manager engine may not receive or apply keyboard events when focus leaves PowerToys windows, but the issue has no current reproduction or device details.
plan: Retest one exact mapping on v0.102.3001 in a PowerToys window and a separate application.
Record the keyboard model and whether KeyboardManagerEngine remains running during the focus change.

verification: Verify the same mapping works in a PowerToys window and a non-PowerToys application while PowerToys remains in the background.
Verify the result is stable after closing or minimizing Settings.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming earlier that the mapping worked only while a PowerToys window was focused. A maintainer already asked for the keyboard model and a bug report, but the issue has no current-build retest or archive; the suggested #32412 concerns a different startup-after-reboot symptom.

Could you please:
1. Retest one exact mapping on v0.102.3001 in a PowerToys window and then in another application while PowerToys stays running, and report the source/target keys.
2. Provide the keyboard model and name any other keyboard remapping software in use.
3. If it still fails outside PowerToys windows, comment /bugreport immediately after reproducing.
This will determine whether the focus-dependent failure remains on the current build.
